name: manual_5fa3f5
claim: A status addendum in a stacked documentation PR must not ratify or authorize a dependent amendment that remains proposed; it must name the dependency and require separate operator ratification against the dependent exact commit.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20 E1 C2 review: a metadata-only Part 1-2 addendum initially blurred the status of a stacked Part 3 proposed amendment. The durable correction preserves the historical addendum boundary, links the dependent PR, and leaves authorization to a later operator statement naming its immutable head.
